app_ideas: PDF-to-skill web app: drag-drop upload, instant Claude Code skill export, freemium with 3 free books/month
Curated skill marketplace: pre-converted skills from top 500 technical books, subscription model for teams

items.monetization: Freemium for individual devs + B2B team licenses for engineering orgs (per-seat/month)
